_provenance.note: LLM reading of the lens token tables; not a measurement

axes.label: Europe (Baltic/Central) ↔ tropical Africa & Central America
axes.rationale: All readouts put European countries on the negative end (Latvia, Lithuania, Slovenia, Germany, Europe, Belgium). The positive end gathers tropical and Global South places: Guinea, Nicaragua, Liberia, Cameroon, Africa, Equ, Sierra, plus 'tropical' and 'cocoa'.

axes.label: Southern/sub-Saharan Africa ↔ Central America & Caribbean
axes.rationale: All four readouts agree on both ends. Positive: Honduras, Nicaragua, Guatemala, Belize, Panama, Mexico. Negative: Madagascar, Sahara, Zimbabwe, Mozambique (Moz), Botswana (Bot), Africa.

axes.label: South America ↔ Middle East / Caucasus
axes.rationale: The negative end is consistently South American: Uruguay, Argentina, Buenos, Brazil, Chile, Bolivia. The positive end has Iraq, Kurdistan, Mosul, Armenia, Azerbaijan, Turkey in the Jacobian and real-logit readouts, while the logit and tuned lenses add 'mountain' tokens.
